The n'” output san[x1,...xn] (written as san[xa] for short) is then computed as a weighted sum of the N value vectors, where the weights are positive and sum to one. a) Output sa; [x,] is computed as a[x1,x1] = 0.1 times the first value vector, a[x2,x1] = 0.3 times the second value vector, and a[x3,x1] = 0.6 times the third value vector. b) Output saz[xe| is computed in the same way, but this time with weights of 0.5, 0.2, and 0.3. ¢) The weighting for output sas[x.| is different again.
